## What and why



## Done when

- [ ] `./dev/check-changed.sh` passes
- [ ] Behaviour, business rules, security boundaries or likely regressions have a test (copy, styling and dead-code removal don't need one)
- [ ] User-facing text exists in both `lt` and `en`
- [ ] A user-facing change has entries in `docs/changelog/v3.md` and `docs/en/changelog/v3.md`, and the guide page for that section is updated
- [ ] UI changes checked on a phone width and in both themes
